having.line: Now give me some of what you're having
stanza: Now give me some of what you're having
I'll take you as a viper into my head
A knife into my bed, arsenic when I'm fed
And I dream a highway back to you

having.line: So I'll take two of what you're having
stanza: I could take a Greyhound home
But when I got there you'd be gone
Along with everything a home is made up of
So I'll take two of what you're having
And I'll take all of what you got
To kill this goddamn lonely, goddamn lonely love

having.line: It's just a dream he keeps having
stanza: It's just a dream he keeps having
And it doesn't seem to mean anything
And it doesn't seem to mean anything
